The British Dialect Quiz
Answer a few questions — see where each answer places you on the map.

The major dialect groups of Great Britain

How you say a few everyday words — and what you call bread, your evening meal, or a splinter — quietly gives away where in Britain you’re from.

This short quiz asks how you speak. After each answer a heat map lights up, showing where in the British Isles that feature is common — all drawn from real published dialect surveys. Work through them and see which corner of the map your speech belongs to.

Powered by the Intellectual Forum at Jesus College, University of Cambridge
